contract_note: release_decision.py (sporely-taxonomy-release-decision-v1) knows only decision 'release_approved', which makes the cloud export importable and lets promotion run. 'release_preparation_approved' is deliberately not that value, so require_release_decision rejects it: no importable export, no import SQL, no desktop promotion until the owner records 'release_approved'.
